About Codility
Company description
Codility helps companies see who can do the job. Candidates and employees complete real work tasks, using AI where the job uses it. Codility scores that work with a published method built by its own team of assessment scientists. Companies use three products: Screen to assess job candidates, Interview to run live interviews, and Skills Intelligence to assess the people they already employ. Each product works for engineering roles and for business roles such as sales, finance and consulting. Codility was founded in 2009 by Greg Jakacki, a competitive programmer. Its library holds more than 1,300 validated tasks in 80+ programming languages and frameworks. In 2026, the International Personnel Assessment Council gave its Innovations in Assessment Award to the scoring method behind Skills Intelligence. Codility is a Leader in technical skills screening on G2. Customers include SAP, GitHub, Bain & Company, BMW Group, Publicis Groupe, Sky, Experian and WHOOP. Codility is a fully remote company with a central base in London.
Short description
Codility helps companies see who can do the job. Candidates and employees complete real work tasks, and Codility scores the work. Companies including SAP, GitHub and BMW Group use it to hire and to assess their current staff, in engineering and business roles. Codility is fully remote, with a central base in London.
